desc: Derive/verify the theory: pairing constraint m ≥ R = na+nb−N, necessity of S ≥ M (max fixed value), maxmatch(S) = Σ_v min(cntA[v], cntB[S−v]), realizability of any m ≥ R, and R ≤ 0 ⇒ "Yes" shortcut; sanity-checked on all three samples.
Implement the full solution (I/O, preprocessing, chunked numpy outer-sum/min grouping with unique+bincount, R ≤ 0 shortcut, Counter fallback, output).
Validation: brute-force equivalence argument on small cases; worst-case timing/memory at N=2000; edge cases (N=2, all −1, no −1, duplicates, 1e9 magnitudes, empty candidate set after S ≥ M mask).
